description: A moment of progress for a WrathPlus character: a level reached, an achievement earned, a quest completed.

main.description: The record key is '<realm>:<guid>:<kind>:<value>' (quests add ':<unix time>', since daily quests repeat), so publishing the same moment twice overwrites one record.

guid.description: The character's guid on that realm (see au.com.artivus.wrathplus.character).

value.description: The level reached, the Achievement.dbc id, or the quest id.

title.description: The achievement's or quest's name, in the realm's language.

level.description: The character's level at the time.
